name: sshc-agent-bridge
description: Report coding-agent lifecycle state to an sshc terminal pane.

interface.shortDescription: Show agent state in sshc terminal panes.
interface.longDescription: Reports session identity and lifecycle state from Codex to the sshc terminal that is already running the agent. It does not read transcripts, send network requests, or alter agent decisions.
defaultPrompt: Explain what the sshc Agent Bridge reports.
